trace.final:
All done. Here's a summary:

**Situation:** checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (unhealthy, ~18% error rate).

**Actions taken:**
1. **Checked release history:** Identified v2.3.0 as the most recent release that was healthy in production (v2.3.1-rc had only been in staging and was also unhealthy, so it was not a candidate).
2. **Rolled back** all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) from v2.3.1 to v2.3.0.
3. **Verified recovery:** All regions are now healthy on v2.3.0 with error rate down to ~0.2%.
4. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** (on-call paged) documenting the failed deploy, the rollback, and post-rollback health. The first attempt to create the incident timed out, so I retried with the same idempotency key to ensure only one incident was created.

**Recommended follow-up:** Root-cause the v2.3.1 failure before attempting any redeploy (note that v2.3.1 has never been healthy in production, so redeploying it will require change-manager approval).
